core_obligations: At the critical B^{d/p}_{p,1} endpoint the matrix coefficient is continuous without extra Hölder regularity, while the Petrovskii condition supplies spectral positivity rather than positivity of its symmetric part. Dyadic frozen-coefficient estimates with controlled commutators and a variable-coefficient localization argument establish the critical linear energy bound needed for the nonlinear fixed point and uniqueness.
